# teltools (vendored)

Telugu transliteration tools by Pradyumna Revur, from
<https://github.com/revurpk/teltools>, licensed under the Apache License 2.0
(see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`).

Vendored into Akshara Office at upstream commit
`4059d6968920f61be6744ca5731a03d9c937bbf6`: the library (`src/lib.rs`),
the shared test vectors (`tests/data/`, generated by upstream from its Rust
binaries) and the romanization cheat sheet (`cheatsheet.html`). Binaries,
the JavaScript port and the Keyman keyboard are not included.

Akshara's local modifications are listed in [`PATCHES.md`](PATCHES.md).
The upstream `trans()` behaviour is unchanged and verified byte-for-byte
against upstream's vectors by `tests/vectors.rs`.
